recentDiary.text: Explored again. Found nothing new. Crickets outside. Feel fine. Still curious.
Went to sleep. Not tired, really. Feel fine. Curious.
Sat in chair at desk, used computer. Looked up how to make piano notes sound good. Saw a saved favorite: GitHub, account kittyxero. Still reading.
Looked up how to make my piano notes sound good in the browser. I found to hold each key down until the last second before the next note, and to play the melody louder than the softer accompaniment.
